title: The effects renderer's own life: alive, then let go of, with async work still in flight
oneLine: An EffectsRenderer's alive-to-destroyed life and every async bake, load or timer that could land after it.
topConcern: None live; only _loadBowStrip's callback lacks the _destroyed check, harmlessly (Assets textures, no bake).

title: The gathering-pose registry: idle, loading, ready or failed, forgotten
oneLine: Each gathering pose's idle/loading/ready/failed record in standIns.js, driven by _standInTriggers and the renderer's makers.
topConcern: 'ready' counts the raw slices, so a skipped skin bake hides your body behind the artist-coloured lumberjack (by design).

title: Your own lumberjack, cook and fire-lighter: baked, re-baked on every look change, shared with peers in your colours
oneLine: Your lumberjack, cook and fire-lighter strips and their colours key, re-baked on every look, drawing or greaves change.
topConcern: A bake throwing on its second strip leaves mixed strips, the colours key null and the old strip never released.

title: Another player's gathering figure, baked in their colours inside one 16 MB allowance
oneLine: Which figure a gathering peer is drawn from: yours, one baked in their colours, or none, within 16 MB.
topConcern: entityRenderer's peek and the draw must reach the same branch each frame; the idle release hides in a try-wrapped draw's tail.

title: A drawn peer's drawings layer over their cook or fire-lighter
oneLine: A drawn peer's tattoo layer over their cook or fire-lighter: baking, ready, evicted or idle-dropped, two per kind.
topConcern: No load timeout and no failure clock: a hung image blocks the layer for good; a refused canvas re-bakes every frame.

title: Your sword and bow stand-in strips: loading, baked, a look marker, or refused and baked the old way
oneLine: Your 21 sword/bow stand-in strips moving between loading, baked, look-palette marker and refused-fallback bake.
topConcern: One crowd fight filling the palette atlas leaves strips as full bakes for the visit; only a look change clears _btNoLook.

title: Peers' swing and shot recolour bakes: kept while on a sprite this frame or the last, then least-recently-used out
oneLine: The LRU of peers' recoloured swing and shot strips, protected by per-frame stamps from freeing a drawn source.
topConcern: The trim skips the sprite walk; safe only because every remote draw sets its texture before showing the sprite.

title: A popup over a head: pushed, minted on first draw, climbing and fading, destroyed by whichever expirer sees it first
oneLine: A damage number or message from push to mint to fade, expired by both the game loop and the renderer.
topConcern: A zone change destroys the Texts but keeps the entries, so the renderer re-mints old-zone popups at old coordinates on the new map.

title: The damage numbers' glyph atlas: installed, warmed on one renderer and its pages emptied, re-installed for a rebuilt renderer, or dropped for the page
oneLine: The damage digits' bitmap font: installed, pages emptied on one renderer's GPU, re-installed after a rebuild, or dropped.
topConcern: Any single throw switches the page to classic Text for good; a rebuilt renderer never retries the install.

title: Another player's dodge roll: set by their broadcast, ended only by this renderer's particle pass
oneLine: A peer's dodge/lunge/dash record and afterimages; started by player_dodge, ended only in this renderer's particle loop.
topConcern: Undrawn peers keep a stale roll: one frame of dodge pose and no shield on reappearing; their snow prints read a stale walk flag.

title: Short-lived world effects the particle pass ages and reaps: hit sparks, death bursts, shock arcs, telegraph zones, impact rings
oneLine: Transient effect lists (hit sparks, bursts, arcs, telegraph zones, impact rings) aged and reaped by the particle pass.
topConcern: Telegraph zones and impact rings have no cap or zone-change clear; a hidden desktop tab grows them until the first frame back.

title: The full-screen flashes and the zone-change colour wipe
oneLine: Full-screen flash stamps (block, level-up, death) and the zone-change colour wipe, drawn and nulled by two files.
topConcern: S._zoneWipe is written as a number but read as {ts, duration}: never drawn, never cleared; S._damageFlash has no writer at all.

title: Projectile sprites: one per live projectile (bolt, special, slime ball) or index pools refilled each frame (arrows, dots)
oneLine: Sprites for live projectiles (back-referenced, reaped by a live set) and index pools for arrows and hit dots.
topConcern: Pools never shrink (up to 700 dot sprites); a goo ball freezes once when the monster-shot atlas becomes ready.

title: The bow's jet-stream streaks: fed while their arrow flies, lingering, then dead
oneLine: Bow jet-stream streaks that outlive their arrows; switched off by JET_STREAM_ENABLED since v2.3.2448.
linked: R3-17 (the sight beam that replaced it)

title: The local monster wind-up ring (m._telegraphUntil)
oneLine: A monster's local wind-up window, written only by the client's local AI that never runs with server monsters.

title: The effects' own pictures that load late or per land: retried icons, crowns.json, the frost burst load-and-free, the pan's fish
oneLine: Late or per-land effect textures (popup icons, crowns.json, arrow blast, frost burst, pan fish) and their retry rules.
topConcern: Retry rules disagree: blast and icons give up for the page; a swallowed burst failure still marks the snowman look ready.

title: The combat marks over monsters: candidate carets, the lock chip's first-second flare, the melee reach ring's pick, the bow's sight line
oneLine: Per-frame combat marks: candidate carets, the lock chip's one-second flare, the reach ring's pick, the bow's sight line.
topConcern: The 'attacking' test is written four times with mixed clocks; the chip and the reach ring disagree about a 0-HP monster.
